description: Use this when the user wants a flashcard maker for supplied question-answer pairs: flip cards interactively, track review progress, print paired cut-out cards as an A4 or Letter PDF, or export an Anki-style Front/Back CSV. Removes identical pairs. Does not generate learning content, check facts, provide spaced repetition, or sync progress. PDF prints Latin with accents, Greek, Cyrillic and Vietnamese; scripts its font lacks (CJK, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Indic, emoji) show as [?]; widget and CSV preserve Unicode. Up to 24 cards and a 2,800-byte payload.

cards.description: Explicit question-answer pairs supplied by the user, e.g. [{question:"hello",answer:"hola"}]. Do not invent answers.

paper.description: PDF paper size, e.g. A4 (default) or Letter.

title.description: Optional deck title, e.g. Spanish greetings.

name: generate_flashcard_deck
title: Generate flashcard deck
